incidents.name: CEXISWAP
incidents.notes: Uninitialized UUPS proxy: attacker calls initialize to seize admin then upgradeToAndCall a malicious implementation.

sources.ref: attacker-event correction: the single Upgraded event on the proxy (block 18182606) is emitted by the exploit tx itself - the attacker's own initialize+upgradeToAndCall is part of the attack, not a protocol code change. The uninitialized proxy was deployed 2021-10-08T13:22:14Z and sat vulnerable until the 2023-09-21 exploit; age measured from deployment: 712.7 days (previously misrecorded as 0s)
